evidence.basis: PEAKS identification score, -10*log10(p); higher is better. Retained by the rule as a var column: one value per feature row (peptide and charge) across all samples, numeric and non-null in all 18 PEAKS LFQ fixtures (range 14.32 to 108.76). How PEAKS combines per-sample identifications into the feature value is not reviewed.

unmapped.reason: PTM site-localization strings such as 'A1:Acetylation (Protein N-term):1000.00' in every PEAKS fixture, not identification confidence.
